recommendations.issue: no spoken line in the first 1.5s
recommendations.fix: Start with the claim, question or payoff line inside the first second.

recommendations.issue: static opening: no cut or strong movement in the first 2s
recommendations.fix: Add a cut, zoom or movement in the first 2s, or open on the most striking frame.

recommendations.issue: attention drops (no visual change, flat audio, no speech)
recommendations.fix: Re-hook: add a cut, zoom or b-roll; add a sound hit or music lift; tease what is coming or ask a question.

recommendations.issue: attention drops (no visual change, low movement, no speech)
recommendations.fix: Re-hook: add a cut, zoom or b-roll; tease what is coming or ask a question.
End on a payoff or loop back to the opening so viewers rewatch.
